description:
The title tells you exactly what this book is about — but you won't believe it until the very last page, because Reid built the entire novel to make you misread the word 'things.'

In this deep dive into "I'm Thinking of Ending Things" by Iain Reid, we unpack every hidden clue — the girlfriend whose name keeps changing, the parents who age between scenes, the janitor chapters you keep skipping — and reveal why this isn't a psychological thriller with a twist ending, but a suicide note disguised as a love story. The horror? You spent the whole book looking at the wrong person.
